title: thelypteris malangae var. sitiorum
intro: Thelypteris malangae var. sitiorum, commonly known as the Malangao fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can help to alleviate various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris malangae var. sitiorum include its antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities, which contribute to its potential in protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
